name: Careers, a day in the life
description: One person’s workday as a timeline of time-stamped moments, beside their photo, role and a short quote.

fields.default: An ordinary Tuesday on the speech team

default.alt: Amara Okafor at her desk in the Toronto office

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Quote
fields.default: The best part of my week is hearing a customer describe a problem I fixed, without knowing I fixed it.

default.title: Coffee and the overnight queue
default.text: Skim the transcripts that failed overnight and pick one to dig into.

default.title: Stand-up, twelve minutes
default.text: Five of us across three time zones. Cameras optional, notes in the doc.

default.title: Deep work on speaker labels
default.text: Two hours with no meetings on the calendar, by team agreement.

default.title: Listen to a customer call
default.text: Every engineer sits in on one interview a week. Today it’s a hospital.

default.title: Pair on the fix
default.text: Ship the change with a teammate in Berlin before their evening.

default.title: Log off
default.text: No one expects replies after six. The pager rotation covers the rest.
